verdict.rationale: The v0 SDK documents API-key authentication (V0_API_KEY) and an OIDC-based option for server-side code deployed on Vercel, so an agent can be given programmatic credentials to the v0 Platform API. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege. Missing for 10: per-key scopes or permission restrictions, per-agent or per-project credential issuance, key expiry and revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
